2022_267_jun_2022_pcard_report.paragraph: Purchasing-card (PCARD) activity report for the Troy School District covering June 2022, submitted to the Board of Education for its August 16, 2022 meeting. The listing is paginated 1 through 24 with every page footer dated 8/11/2022, and each line records a transaction description, the journal-entry description "JUN PCARD EXP", a budget unit, an A/C code, a transaction amount and a credits column, for charges posted between 5/26/2022 and 6/27/2022. The report closes with a Subtotal of 250,021.70 in charges against 3,730.79 in credits, and Total Expenses of 246,290.91.

**Report identification**
TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, June 2022. Board of Education meeting date 2022-08-16; every page footer carries the run date 8/11/2022 and the pages are numbered 1 through 24.

**Format**
Each page repeats the column header line: Transaction Description / JE Description / Budget Unit / A/C Code / Transaction Amount / Credits. Every line carries the journal-entry description "JUN PCARD EXP". Transaction descriptions combine the posting date with a truncated merchant name (for example "6/6/2022-YMCA CAMP CO"). Posting dates range from 5/26/2022 through 6/27/2022. Budget units are fifteen-digit strings whose leading digits identify the fund — 101 (general fund), 120 and 122 (grant and special-education units), 419, 529, 530, 531, 535, and 700/701 (student activity and internal accounts). A/C codes appearing include 3190, 3210, 3220, 3410, 3430, 3450, 3510, 3610, 4120, 4130, 4220, 5000, 5110, 5210, 5310, 5410, 5610, 5910, 5990, 6410, 7410 and 7910.

**Credits**
The credits column is used for refunds and reversals. The largest is 6/6/2022-HOTEL IROQUO at 1,711.05 (101150232090000, code 3220). Others include 6/13/2022-SSL ECOMM 399.32, 6/23/2022-CITY OF TROY 300.00 (700071399910700), 6/15/2022-SAVVY SLIDER 239.97, 6/17/2022-AMAZON.COM A 122.68, 6/23/2022-CITY OF TROY 150.00 (531004118620000 and 120317331684900), 6/14/2022-AMZN MKTP US 106.00, 6/27/2022-SP SIMPLY EL 94.92, 6/22/2022-SMUGMUG.COM 75.00, 6/10/2022-HALF DAY CAF 51.94, 6/15/2022-TARGET 39.00, 6/23/2022-STAPLS735914 34.75, 6/10/2022-AMZN MKTP US 19.99, 6/9/2022-AUTOZONE 437 19.49, 6/8/2022-AMZ*HEARTORI 17.36 and 6/3/2022-SPOTIFY 9.99.

**Spending themes**
Field trips and end-of-year events dominate the 700-fund student activity units: Detroit Zoological, The Henry Ford, Troy Historical, TreeRunner Adventure, Troy Nature Society, Camp Ticonderoga and YMCA Camp. Instructional supply purchases run heavily through Amazon, Staples, Scholastic, Capstone, Booksource and Lakeshore Learning. Operations and maintenance units (1019xx) cover Poolweb, Uline, J & J Truck, Halogen Supply, Lowe's, Detroit Battery and MSBO/state permit fees. Technology charges include Apple, Monoprice, CDW-G, Zoom, Microsoft and Vimeo. Athletics units (7000703xx) carry BSN Sports, Elite Sports, Monogram, Bloomfield officials and Logo Zone. Conference travel appears under codes 3210/3220/7910 for Ball State, Galt House, Hotel Montele, Wyndham Garden, Four Points, Holiday Inn, Delta and Priceline.
